_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Fear/greed 51 and flat 30d momentum sit inside Complacency with only 7% of recent windows breaking ±2, so the coil default is HOLD until a confirmed breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency; narrative describes positive industrial/equity flow but supplies no forward phase or direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains rangebound, fear/greed holds 47-54, and ETF flows plus 30d momentum stay flat
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound with 30d momentum break higher, or skew/funding unwind drives fear/greed below 39
